title: Foundation Engine
description: A 3D engine built from scratch in C++ with HLSL compute shaders.
content: This project involved creating a 3D engine from the ground up using C++ for the core logic and HLSL for compute shaders.
The engine supports basic rendering, lighting, and camera controls. It was a challenging yet rewarding experience that deepened
my understanding of graphics programming and low-level system architecture.

title: Real-Time SDF Renderer
description: A compute-shader-driven signed distance field renderer using Jump Flooding.
content: This project implements a real-time SDF pipeline using a compute shader and the Jump Flooding Algorithm.
The system supports dynamic shapes, smooth blending, and distance-based effects.
I built this as part of my engine modernization work, focusing on GPU-driven pipelines.

title: Engine Architecture Refactor
description: A full modernization of a custom 3D engine with modular systems and improved tooling.
content: This was a long-term project to restructure an older engine into a modular, maintainable architecture.
I introduced a render graph, event dispatcher, improved memory allocators, and a modern build pipeline.
The refactor dramatically improved iteration speed and debugging clarity.

title: Battlefield Portal XP Mode
description: A custom XP farming mode built using Battlefield Portal scripting tools.
content: This project explores the Battlefield Portal scripting system to create a rewarding XP loop.
I designed custom logic for enemy spawning, scoring, and pacing.
The mode was built for experimentation and fun, while learning the constraints of Portal scripting.

title: Custom Pool Allocator
description: A modern C++ pool allocator with alignment, lifetime management, and debugging tools.
content: This allocator was built to support high-performance engine subsystems.
It uses fixed-size blocks, alignment guarantees, and explicit lifetime management.
I also added debugging features like allocation tracking and guard regions.

title: Runtime SDF Text Rendering
description: A GPU-driven text rendering system using runtime SDF generation.
content: This project generates signed distance fields for text at runtime using compute shaders.
It supports crisp scaling, outline effects, and dynamic glyph caching.
The system integrates into the engine's render graph for efficient batching.
